verdict.rationale: Shortwave's docs describe event-driven triggers that draft replies when emails arrive, add team comments, organize threads into todos and connect to 3,000+ apps. Custom AI filters written in plain English automatically label, star and archive mail, and a Tasklet integration takes action on emails automatically. Together these cover background, autonomous automation, but the evidence is mostly short changelog and marketing lines. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger configuration, scope and limits; independent or hands-on confirmation that triggers and filters run reliably unattended; clarity on how much autonomy is native versus delegated to Tasklet or Zapier.
